about: Register with DHA as a healthcare professional so a facility can later activate your licence.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: You must pass the related assessment within 3 attempts across the authorities
You must first receive the primary source verification result for your documents
documents: Good Standing Certificate valid within six months
Verification result of your qualifications and experience, and an assessment result if required
timing: Registration is valid for one year
